verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say its first-party CLI (runpodctl) is open source, so part of the product's source is readable. Nothing shows the core GPU cloud platform (Pods, Serverless, Clusters) is open-source, and no license is named. Missing for 10: evidence that the core platform source is available, a named open license (e.g. MIT/Apache), a repository link, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Runpod CLI is an open source command-line tool for managing your Runpod resources from your local machine.
Runpod CLI is an open source command-line tool for managing your Runpod resources from your local machine. You can manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and models
